prompts.name: grounded_qa
prompts.description: Baseline grounded Q&A. Citations use [doc_title, chunk N] format appended per-claim; context blocks are unlabelled.

prompts.name: grounded_qa
prompts.description: Inline [N] citation markers. Context blocks are numbered [1]...[N]; rule 3 requires per-claim [N] placement with explicit don't-group and don't-use-other-formats sub-rules.

prompts.name: sufficiency_assessment
prompts.description: Assesses whether retrieved context chunks are sufficient to fully answer a question. Returns JSON with is_sufficient, reasoning, missing_aspects, and confidence.

prompts.name: query_reformulation
prompts.description: Generates a focused new search query targeting what's missing from a prior retrieval. Returns bare query text (no JSON, no quotes) for direct embedding.

prompts.name: partial_answer
prompts.description: Cap-reached honest answer: answers only what the chunks support and names missing_aspects the retrieval loop could not find.
